world.title: Video: Plumes Of Smoke, Fire Emerge From Aramco Facility Near Riyadh
world.summary: A significant fire and smoke were reported near an Aramco facility in Riyadh on Saturday, according to a witness. This incident occurs amid heightened tensions between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis, who have increased attacks on Saudi cities and energy infrastructure. Saudi authorities have not yet confirmed the fire, and Aramco has not provided immediate comments.

world.title: India close 2026 Asian Games campaign with 85 medals, including 21 gold: Where does this performance rank compared to previous editions?
world.summary: India concluded its 2026 Asian Games campaign with a total of 85 medals, comprising 21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze. The performance was highlighted by strong showings in wrestling, cricket, and hockey. This achievement marks a significant contribution to India's medal tally, reflecting an impressive effort, particularly noted for a late surge on the final competition day.

world.title: 'Most comprehensive plan': Ukraine confirms India playing role in mediating energy truce in Black Sea
world.summary: Ukraine has acknowledged India's significant role in mediating a potential energy truce in the Black Sea, highlighting its efforts towards a negotiated resolution to the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. The recognition comes amid increased diplomatic engagements, with Ukrainian officials emphasizing India's contributions as crucial in seeking peace. This development marks a notable shift in India's involvement in international conflict resolution efforts.

business.title: TVS September 2026 Sales: 23% YoY Growth, 6.46 Lakh Units
business.summary: TVS Motor Company reported total sales of over 6.72 lakh units in September 2026, marking a 23% year-on-year growth. Electric two-wheeler sales surged by 110%, with 65,799 units sold during the month. This significant increase reflects the company's expanding presence in the electric vehicle market, contributing to overall sales performance across both two-wheeler and three-wheeler segments.

business.title: Honda Elevate Facelift New Details Confirmed Ahead of 6 October Launch
business.summary: Honda Cars India has confirmed new styling elements and features for the Elevate facelift, set to launch on 6 October. Pre-bookings are currently open at a price of Rs 21,000. The company has released a teaser showcasing the updated exterior design, with official pricing to be announced on the launch date.

business.title: Nestle low fat dairy whitener declared unsafe, substandard by FSSAI
business.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has declared a sample of Nestle's Low Fat Dairy Whitener unsafe and substandard after laboratory analysis. Bharat Hotels has been instructed to cease selling the product, and consumers are advised to check the affected batches. The decision follows a sample collection from Bharat Hotels' premises for testing.

technology.title: Buying a New iPhone 18 or Android Phone? Read These Tips Before You Spend Your Cash
technology.summary: When purchasing a new smartphone, consider models like the iPhone 18 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and Google Pixel 11 Pro, which are top choices in 2026. These devices feature powerful processors and excellent photography capabilities. It's essential to evaluate specifications, performance, and user needs before making a decision to ensure the best investment for your requirements.

technology.title: Nothing announces Big Billion Days offers on Phone (4a), 4a Pro and 4b
technology.summary: Nothing has announced special offers on its latest smartphones, including the Phone (4a), Phone (4a) Pro, and Phone (4b), ahead of Flipkart's Big Billion Days sale. The promotions include price cuts, bank discounts, and exchange benefits, making festive smartphone shopping more appealing for consumers. These offers aim to enhance the shopping experience during the upcoming sale event.

technology.title: Jennifer Doudna’s team found an ancient CRISPR ancestor in viruses using a never-before-seen 'gapped' DNA code; the smaller VIPR system can target broadly and may become a new gene-editing tool
technology.summary: Jennifer Doudna's team discovered an ancient CRISPR ancestor in viruses, revealing a novel 'gapped' DNA code. This smaller VIPR system can broadly target and may serve as a new gene-editing tool. The findings suggest that viral competition influenced the evolution of this molecular weapon, reshaping current understanding of CRISPR's origins and its potential applications in genetic research.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026, Day 15: Indian results on October 3 - How many medals did India win?
sports.summary: On October 3, Indian athletes achieved notable success at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Kumkum Mohod secured a gold medal in the Women’s Recurve Individual event, defeating South Korea’s Oh Yejin in a shoot-off. Neeraj Chauhan earned a bronze medal in the Men’s Recurve Individual, overcoming compatriot Dhiraj Bommadevara with a score of 6-4.

sports.title: India ease out Malaysia in final to win gold and Olympic quota
sports.summary: India triumphed over Malaysia 5-1 in the Asian Games 2026 hockey final, securing the gold medal and an Olympic quota. The match took place at the Gifu Prefectural Green Stadium in Kakamigahara, Japan. Captain Harmanpreet Singh scored twice, with additional goals from Jugraj Singh and Hardik Singh, contributing to India's decisive victory on Saturday.

sports.title: Harmanpreet Singh leads the charge as India tear through Malaysia 5-1 for Asian Games men's hockey gold; seal LA28 Olympics spot
sports.summary: The Indian men's hockey team won the Asian Games gold medal by defeating Malaysia 5-1 in Gifu, Japan. Harmanpreet Singh led the team, which successfully defended its title from the previous Games. This victory also secured India a place in the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The match showcased India's dominance in the sport at the continental level.

health.title: Breast cancer cases rise among women aged 25-35, experts flag concern
health.summary: Breast cancer cases among women aged 25-35 are rising, raising concerns among health experts. Historically, the disease was more prevalent in older women, but recent data indicates a significant increase in younger patients. This trend underscores the importance of heightened awareness and early intervention regarding breast health for younger women to address this emerging health issue effectively.

health.title: Affordable ways to protect your gut microbiome from unhealthy changes
health.summary: Maintaining a healthy gut microbiome is crucial for reducing risks of diseases like cancer, brain disorders, and cardiovascular issues. Affordable dietary changes can significantly enhance gut health. Simple actions, such as incorporating fiber-rich foods and probiotics, can support the trillions of bacteria in the intestines. Investing in gut health can lead to better overall well-being and disease prevention.

health.title: Are we taking too many antidepressants?
health.summary: Doctors are raising concerns about the increasing prescriptions of Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs) for everyday emotional distress and temporary stress. Dr. Monica Chib from Indraprastha Apollo Hospital notes a gradual rise in SSRI use, attributing it to heightened mental health awareness and better access to treatment. Caution is advised regarding their use for non-clinical emotional challenges.

science.title: You won’t believe which countries hide the world’s most incredible fossil treasures
science.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
science.summary: North America is home to some of the richest Mesozoic fossil records globally, particularly in the Hell Creek Formation, which spans Montana, Wyoming, and the Dakotas. This region has yielded famous specimens such as Tyrannosaurus rex and Triceratops. Additionally, Utah's geological wealth contributes significantly to the continent's fossil treasures, showcasing a diverse array of prehistoric life.

science.title: A signal from beyond: Astronomers detect radio waves from a planet 63 light-years away
science.summary: Astronomers have detected a mysterious radio signal from a planet located 63 light-years away, prompting speculation about extraterrestrial communication. However, experts suggest the signal is likely caused by natural phenomena, specifically magnetic activity. This discovery highlights the ongoing exploration of deep space and the complexities of interpreting signals from distant celestial bodies, steering clear of sensational interpretations.

science.title: Astronomers Detect Radio Signals from Beta Pictoris b
science.summary: On 23 September 2026, scientists announced the first direct detection of radio signals from an exoplanet, Beta Pictoris b. This gas giant is located approximately 63 to 64 light-years from Earth. The signals were detected using South Africa's MeerKAT radio telescope, marking a significant milestone in exoplanet research and enhancing understanding of planetary atmospheres and their interactions with stellar winds.

entertainment.title: Vijay Deverakonda feels Rashmika Mandanna has brought 'celebration' into his life; shares, ‘I’ve decided to take more holidays’
entertainment.summary: Vijay Deverakonda expressed that Rashmika Mandanna has introduced a sense of 'celebration' into his life, leading him to decide on taking more holidays. The couple will appear together on screen for the first time following their much-publicized wedding in the upcoming period action drama ‘Ranabaali’. Promotions for the film have highlighted their relationship and collaboration.

entertainment.title: Jr. NTR slams morphed ‘Chuttamalle’ video featuring Janhvi Kapoor, vows to take legal action
entertainment.summary: Telugu actor Jr. NTR has condemned a morphed AI-generated video featuring Janhvi Kapoor from the music video "Chuttamalle" of the film Devara. The altered clip, which has circulated on social media, includes sexually explicit content. Jr. NTR announced intentions to pursue legal action against those responsible for creating and disseminating the inappropriate video.

entertainment.title: CM Vijay Cheers For Son Jason Sanjay’s Sigma With Special Roadshow Gesture
entertainment.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay publicly supported his son, Jason Sanjay, during a roadshow for Jason's directorial debut, "Sigma," which stars Sundeep Kishan and premiered on October 2. Vijay proudly displayed a framed picture of Jason from the film, engaging with the crowds to celebrate this milestone in his son's career. The event highlighted familial pride and support.
